scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend,admin" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta,cyan" --kill-others --raw "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:frontend" "pnpm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:ci: concurrently --names "backend,frontend,admin" --kill-others --raw "pnpm run dev:ci:backend" "pnpm run dev:ci:frontend" "pnpm run dev:ci:admin"
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @app/backend exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB
scripts.gen:prod-config: TARGET=production DB_NAME=project-name-prod DB_ID=$(pnpm --silent --filter @app/backend exec wrangler d1 info project-name-prod --json | jq -r .uuid) node scripts/gen-wrangler-config.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm build && pnpm gen:prod-config && pnpm --filter @app/backend exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config dist/worker/wrangler.generated.production.json --remote
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && pnpm gen:prod-config && pnpm --filter @app/backend exec wrangler deploy --config dist/worker/wrangler.generated.production.json
